caption: The drawing depicts two objects: a large, round, brown metallic pan or warming pan with a short cylindrical handle at the top, and an elongated metal rod with a shallow bowl at one end, drawn in simple black outline below the main pan. The pan has intricate decorative engravings on its lid, including symmetrical floral or foliate designs, small stars, and the number "22" at the top center in the middle of the lid. There is a ring attached near the bottom edge of the pan, and the metal appears polished with various shades of brown and gold indicating highlights and shadows. The rod below is plain and uncolored except for the fastening detail connecting the handle to the bowl. The background is plain, off-white, and there are no other objects or shading.
title: Warming Pan
